review: Plaque v6 becomes the default plaque model (maintainer's choice 2026-10-25): the plaque_model setting tooltip names toxoplasma_plaque_v6, trained on resized wells, which turns plaque well resize on; toxoplasma_plaque_v5 is the previous default and toxoplasma_plaque_v3 stays the better choice on Gel Doc wells; the 'bundled' note names toxoplasma_plaque_v6. Preserve every model key, Gel Doc and Cellpose 3. Superseded records are archived in archive/2026-10-25-plaque-v6-default.

records.source: Cellpose checkpoint used to segment plaques: a model-zoo key downloads a checksum-verified checkpoint on first use ('toxoplasma_plaque_v6' was trained on resized wells and turns plaque well resize on; 'toxoplasma_plaque_v5', the previous default, segments images as they are; 'toxoplasma_plaque_v3' scores higher on Gel Doc wells), a filesystem path selects a custom checkpoint, and 'bundled' is a Cellpose 3 checkpoint that needs Cellpose 3. Changing it changes plaque counts, so recorded runs should keep their value. Default 'toxoplasma_plaque_v6'.
records.translation: Vistað Cellpose-líkan til hlutaskiptingar á skellum: lykill í líkanasafni sækir líkan við fyrstu notkun og sannreynir gátsummu þess ('toxoplasma_plaque_v6' var þjálfað á brunnum með breyttri stærð og kveikir á stærðarbreytingu skellubrunna; 'toxoplasma_plaque_v5', fyrra sjálfgefna líkanið, hlutar myndir eins og þær eru; 'toxoplasma_plaque_v3' skorar hærra á Gel Doc-brunnum), skráarslóð velur eigið vistað líkan, og 'bundled' er vistað Cellpose 3-líkan sem þarf Cellpose 3. Breyting breytir skellutalningum, svo skráðar keyrslur ættu að varðveita gildi sitt. Sjálfgefið 'toxoplasma_plaque_v6'.

records.key: 'bundled' is the historical packaged plaque model. It is kept so an old run can be reproduced; it misses about a third of the plaques on literature images. toxoplasma_plaque_v6 is the current model.
